candidates.rationale: The source performs element-wise pointer offset while preserving provenance. Current vstd has no NonNull pointer view or allocation witness for expressing the result and its in-bounds safety condition.

The source delegates to raw-pointer offset_from. Relating the result to the address difference requires observable NonNull pointer data plus same-allocation, non-ZST, and representability conditions unavailable through this signature.

The source delegates to unsigned raw-pointer subtraction. Its useful relation requires pointer addresses, common allocation provenance, element divisibility, and ordering, but the exact NonNull-only signature exposes none of the required logical witnesses.

The source reads a bitwise copy while leaving memory bytes unchanged. A sound contract must relate the result to initialized memory and account for ownership of non-Copy values, but the signature carries no PointsTo permission.

The source reads initialized memory without requiring alignment. Current vstd PointsTo permissions enforce alignment, and this signature carries neither a memory permission nor an unaligned byte-content abstraction.

The source performs an observable volatile read that may access I/O memory and participates in volatile ordering. Current vstd has no volatile-event or external-memory state model, and the signature carries no memory permission.
